content: Pre-training methods draw a lot of attention recently. peters2018deep and radford:2019:arxiv pre-trained LSTM and Transformer encoders using language modeling objectives. To leverage the context in both directions, BIBREF2 proposed BERT, which is trained with the mask language modeling objective. XLNet BIBREF3 is trained with permutation language modeling objective, which removes the independence assumption of masked tokens in BERT. RoBERTa BIBREF4 extends BERT with more training data and better training strategies. All the methods above focus on pre-training an encoder, while we propose methods to pre-train both the encoder and decoder of a seq2seq model.
